tenderSchedule.title: Periodical Special Assistance for the Annual Overhauling/Routine Preventive/Breakdown/emergencymaintenance works of I&C Systems/equipments pertains to Units-5 to 8 MRHS,SPM Analyzers,HFO tank level and Bunker Level Monitoring systems for a period Of ONE year.
tenderSchedule.description: Routine monitoring / Preventive maintenance / Breakdown / Emergency /Regular servicing of pneumatic cylinders, solenoid valves, Limit switches & Pressures switches pertainsto Units-5,6 &7 Mill Reject Handling System(MRHS).Operation and maintenance of Dense Phase Mill Reject Handling Systemof Unit-8.The work involves-a)Operation and maintenance of DPMRHS PLC systemb)I&C Maintenance works of Air Compressor.c)Servicing/re-calibration of solenoid valves,Limit/proximity switches & Pressures switches etc.Routine monitoring/maintenance of SPM analyzer systemspertains to Unit-5 to 8.The work involves-a)Operation and maintenance of DPMRHS PLC system.b)I&C Maintenance works of Air Compressor.c)Servicing/re-calibration of solenoid valves, Limit/proximity switches & Pressures switches etc.Routine monitoring/maintenance of SPM analyzer systems pertains to Unit-5 to 8.The work involves-a)Cleaning/servicing of transmitters & Reflector units and blower filters of SPM analyzers, pertains to Units-5 to 8.b)Carrying out maintenance works under the supervision of I&C engineerRegular monitoring/checking healthiness of Unit-7&8 coal bunker level monitoring systems.Routine maintenance of bunker level monitoring systems.The work involves- a) Cleaning/Checking of 3D Level sensors.b) Cleaning/checking healthiness of local control panel at bunker floor.c) Ensuring healthiness of signals to Control Room PC,DCS&CHP control room digital indicators.Regular monitoring/maintenance of HFO tanks Level measurement systems.The work involves-a)Cleaning/checking healthiness of Radar Level Transmitters installed at HFO tanksb)Cleaning/checking healthiness of local digital indicators installed at FOPH.c)Cleaning/checking healthiness of PLC unit installed at Unit Control Room-7.The nature of work is round the clock maintenance.The cleaning/servicing and maintenance works of all the above mentioned systems shall be carried out during units AOH period.The required T&P and PPE for carrying out maintenance works shall be arranged by the contractor/agency itself.

itemList.description: Supervision of I&C works pertaining to Unit-5 to 7 MRHS, Unit-8 DPMRHS, HFO tanks level measurement systems, bunker level measurement system, Unit-5 to 8 SPM analyzers.
Assisting Plant Operation and Maintenance works of DPMRHS I&C systems/equipments of Unit-8 (1X250 MW).
Maintenance of Unit-5,6&7 MRHS System pertaining to A to F Mills along with its field pneumatic cylinders, solenoid valves, Air filter regulators, field local junction boxes and control panels.

Maintenance of Unit -5 to8 bunker level monitoring system consisting of A to F bunker level sensors, transmitters and its local control panels, HFO tanks-1&2 Level transmitters, local digital indicators & PLC systems.
Maintenance of Unit-5 to 8 SPM analyzers involves cleaning/servicing of local sensors, filters, purging blower systems and associated field instruments.
